column1: # Stepwise annual hydrogen offtake demand for the electrolyzer redesign (W8) -- v2 (2026-08-12).
# DESIGN v2: the demand curve now EXTENDS BEYOND the TYNDP-22 total so that the model's
# calibrated quantity (multiplier 1.00 in hydrogen_demand_scenarios.csv) is an INTERIOR point
# of the curve rather than its maximum: width_shares sum to 1.40 (max ~ corrected TYNDP-24 GA
# upper range; see SOURCES.md sec. 4) and the must-serve floor is 0.50 (= the old ad-hoc 2035
# reduction coefficient; now segment-derived). Serving steps 1-5 = exactly 1.00 x TYNDP-22.
# must_serve=1 steps stay a FORCED annual equality (contracted/process-critical; scarcity rent
# possible in tight years). must_serve=0 steps are annual variables E_s in [0; width] valued at
# eta x (wtp + node premium); they self-curtail when power prices exceed the WTP.
# Must-serve widths follow the TYNDP-24 sectoral structure of final H2 demand (EU27: industry
# 62-77%; transport 16-24%; buildings/households 3-16%); elastic widths are cross-sector
# PARITY TRANCHES (price-based; not sector quotas). NO hourly H2 balance (implicit free
# intra-year storage -- state as limitation). Per-node premium added from
# hydrogen_demand_node_premium.csv. STATUS: proposed v2 -- awaiting sign-off + test run.
